clue.text: Hey! That butcher must be ordered to stop fighting

parts.note: taken as written, part of the fodder
taken as written, part of the fodder
taken as written, part of the fodder

explanation.surface: Someone shouts at an aggressive butcher, telling them to stop brawling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'must be ordered' sounds like a command to the butcher, but it tells you to rearrange the fourteen letters of HEY THAT BUTCHER.
explanation.definitionFit: To make peace after a quarrel is an idiom drawn from the custom of laying down a tomahawk when ending hostilities.

clue.text: Old-fashioned, as commuting solvers appear?

clue.text: Waves in which hair may set?

explanation.definitionFit: Teeny is informal for tiny, very small.

clue.text: Eastern woman seen around is Siam's first envoy

explanation.definitionFit: Astray means wandering away from the correct path.

explanation.definitionFit: A cadetship is a post as a trainee officer in the services or police.

clue.text: Disposed to gripe? It's a boost to self-esteem

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: An ego trip is an activity done chiefly to feed one's vanity or sense of importance.

clue.text: Oddly, one can do this when one's lips are sealed

explanation.definitionFit: A scholar who specialises in ancient Greek language and culture is called by this term.

clue.text: Poor explanation we gave convinced nobody, finally

clue.text: Exhausted party man in backward old government department

explanation.definitionFit: Shattered is informal British slang for utterly tired out.

clue.text: Club, perhaps, follows match still on TV

explanation.definitionFit: This was a fixed image shown by broadcasters outside programme hours, a still picture.

clue.text: He composed work popular with church

clue.text: Coastal fort in ruin? Don't say anything

the nothing in tell nothing is O, the figure zero

explanation.surface: Someone sees a crumbling fort by the sea and asks you to keep quiet about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Don't say anything' is recast as 'tell nothing': TELL + O. MARTELLO towers are small round forts built along Britain's coast against Napoleon.
explanation.definitionFit: These round defensive towers were built along British coasts in the Napoleonic era.

clue.text: Ascetic finding some impureness easy to reject
